stops.note: Romans believed the leopard was a cross between a lion ('leo') and a panther ('pardus')
formed from leo (lion) and pardus (panther), once thought to be a lion-panther hybrid
carried into French for the spotted big cat
settled as the English word for the spotted big cat
stops.meaning: a spotted big cat native to Africa and Asia

current_meaning: a large spotted wild cat native to Africa and Asia
